ratchetRule: ICTC 1.2 Semantic Integrity & Authority Closure binds post-cutover semantic history and EpistemicStep digests to the audit chain, materializes declared multi-subject AFTER-state occurrences in one manifest, keeps the mutable working set bounded, fails closed on unsupported historical transaction selection, separates initiator/executor/producer authority, converges trace/evidence proof on current semantic projections, materializes dependency review from one persisted ledger and requires a later human decision to resolve it. AI remains proposal-only; catalogue provenance, organizational use, requirement applicability, mapping and effectiveness remain distinct.
limitations: 1.2 Market Candidate is a bounded product profile, not legal compliance, certification or universal production readiness.
Catalogue provenance, organizational standard use and requirement applicability are distinct; none validates a standard or establishes compliance.
ControlTest records one bounded effectiveness observation and never creates a compliance conclusion.
Proprietary normative text is not bundled without appropriate authorization.
Crosswalks and shared control objectives do not establish legal equivalence or inherited compliance.
AI OFF preserves manual business paths; automatic discovery still requires an enabled discovery service.
Pre-cutover records may have partial historical materialization; full historical state reconstruction remains unsupported.
transactionAsOf on a current-state projection is provenance metadata, not a historical-state selector; historical selection is unsupported and fails closed in this release.
The SubjectVersion bootstrap index is a bounded working view over complete append storage; occurrence, payload and recorded digest bindings remain queryable from persistence.
Secondary semantic subjects are declared by trusted server-side command code and resolved from AFTER-state; client request metadata is not a semantic-subject authority.
Fixed-taxonomy 10k scenario activation is not proof of unknown-unknown saturation; fault mutation falsifiers are a separate evidence class.
Independent human comprehension, penetration testing and market fit remain not-assessed without external evidence.
